Name: (CP) Dirt To Grass Unofficial Update For 1.6
Author: marchareui
Description:
[center][b][size=6]感谢[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8049772]Draylon[/url]﻿的制作和授权(ฅ´ω`ฅ)[/size][/b]
[b][size=6]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/8049772]Draylon[/url]﻿ for his work and authorization<3[/size]
Original version: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10436][size=2]Dirt to Grass [/size][/url]﻿


[/b]----------------------------------------------------------------

[size=5][b]更新[/b][/size]
[size=3]考虑到大多数人只使用一种着色，[/size]
[size=3]于是为了启动更快我把这几种着色做成了单独的mod，[/size]
[color=#fff2cc][size=3]安装时只需复制与您的着色相匹配的版本至Mods文件夹，[/size]
[size=3]请不要全部复制。[/size][/color]
[size=3]如果您下载了我之前发布的版本，请全部删除后再安装更新，谢谢~[/size]
[size=3]如果您需要整合版本请留言，我有时间会做的=3=[/size]

[size=5][b]Update[/b][/size]
[size=4]Since most people typically use only one of the multiple recolors available,
I've created separate editions to reduce startup time.
[color=#fff2cc]When using this mod, please ensure that you only copy the file that matches your chosen recolor,
rather than copying all of them into the Mods folder. [/color]
Additionally, if you have previously downloaded the old version of this mod,
please delete all of those files before updating.
If you require the combined edition, please let me know in the comments, and I'll do my best to accommodate your request.[/size]

----------------------------------------------------------------
[size=5]
[b]使用方法[/b][/size]
[size=3]1.删除旧版本
2.解压后选择你需要的版本
3.将其复制至mods文件夹
[/size]
[size=5][b]适用mod指路[/b][/size]
[b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20698]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085][size=3]Starblue Valley[/size][/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635][size=3]Blue Grass Recolor[/size][/url]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21289]Outdoors Terrain Recolor[/url]
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255][size=3]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/size]
[/url][b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url]﻿[/size][/b][size=3]：[/size][size=2]请使用 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995?tab=posts]该mod评论区中Tvisland的贴图[/url] 手动更新[/size]


[size=6][b]Method[/b][/size][size=3]
1.Delete the old version
2.Unzip the new version and find your matched file
3.Copy this matched file into Mods[/size]

[size=6][b]Compatible Recolors[/b][/size]
[b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20698]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635][size=3]Blue Grass Recolor[/size][/url]﻿
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21289]Outdoors Terrain Recolor[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url]﻿
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995][size=3]A Wittily Named Recolor[/size][/url][b] [/b][size=2]:Please utilize [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995?tab=posts][b]Tvisland's Tilesheet[/b][/url] (you can find it in the posts) to update manually[b]﻿[/b]
